abstract:
BACKGROUND: Surgery for locally advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (LA-PDAC) remains technically demanding, particularly in presence of extensive venous involvement. A temporary mesenterico-portal shunt (TMPS) facilitates long venous resection and enables safe arterial resection, but evidence is limited to small series. We report technique and outcomes from the largest cohort of TMPS, an approach described at our center.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: All pancreatic resections performed with TMPS between January 2007 and December 2024 were retrospectively reviewed. Operative and survival outcomes were analyzed.
RESULTS: 155 LA-PDAC patients underwent TMPS placement. Most had LA-PDAC (92%) and received preoperative chemotherapy (89%), mainly FOLFIRINOX-based (86.9%). Complete venous obstruction (Nakao D) was present in 48.1%. Procedures included pancreatoduodenectomy (62%), total (24.5%), and distal pancreatectomy (13.5%). All patients underwent venous resection; 75% also required arterial resection, most commonly of the superior mesenteric artery (61%). Mean operative time was 610 min (range 180-1145 min). Postoperative mortality was 6.4%, and R0 resection was achieved in 56%. The median OS from diagnosis was 32.7 months (95% confidence interval [CI] 23.5-42.00 months).The median OS from surgery was 17.46 months (95% CI 13.2-21.6 months), with 1-, 3, and 5-year survival rates of 70%, 29%, and 21%, respectively.
CONCLUSIONS: TMPS is a standardized and reproducible technique that facilitates management of complex venous resection and may enhance the feasibility of arterial resection in selected patients with LA-PDAC.
key_points_ko: 총 155명의 국소 진행성 췌장관암(LA-PDAC) 환자가 일시적 장간막문맥 단락술(TMPS)을 받았습니다.
진단 시점부터의 전체 생존기간(OS) 중앙값은 32.7개월, 수술 시점부터는 17.46개월이었습니다.
수술 후 사망률은 6.4%, R0 절제율(암세포가 남지 않게 절제된 비율)은 56%를 기록했습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 국소 진행성 췌장관암(LA-PDAC) 환자 155명을 대상으로 일시적 장간막문맥 단락술(TMPS)을 적용한 대규모 환자군의 수술 및 생존 결과를 후향적으로 분석했습니다. 대부분의 환자가 수술 전 항암치료를 받았으며 정맥 절제술과 함께 동맥 절제술도 시행되었습니다. 전체 생존기간(OS) 중앙값은 진단 시점부터 32.7개월, 수술 시점부터 17.46개월로 나타났습니다. 수술 후 사망률은 6.4%, R0 절제율은 56%였습니다. 연구진은 TMPS가 복잡한 정맥 절제와 동맥 절제를 용이하게 하는 표준화되고 재현 가능한 기법이라고 결론지었습니다.
title: Mesentericoportal Venous Shunting in Surgery for Locally Advanced Pancreatic Tumors: Results of a Standardized Approach for Oncovascular Pancreatic Surgery
title_ko: 국소 진행성 췌장암 수술 시 장간막문맥 단락술: 종양혈관 췌장 수술을 위한 표준화된 접근법의 결과
